Fix implemented (commit 91c6ccebd0, Change-Id I8b49f3304940fc8a79ff4924a062fcc9bababead). Part 2 per-site disposition for the 5 emit_gate_error sites in workflow/gate_dispatch.py:

- plan_review preflight (~122): NO counters (legitimate) — raises before the run and before the recorder exists; zero billable work. Code comment added.
- plan_review mid-run (~180): passes diagnostic — recorder in scope; threads consumed-so-far via _consumed_diagnostic(rec) (None if the outage hit the very first call).
- code_review preflight (~351): NO counters (legitimate) — before run/recorder. Comment added.
- code_review mid-run (~467): passes diagnostic — prep.rec in scope; _consumed_diagnostic(prep.rec).
- completion preflight (~530): NO counters (legitimate) — before run/recorder; the mid-run completion outage is already covered by completion_recovery.raise_completion_workflow_failure's gate_error diagnostic. Comment added.

Part 1: requests/tool_calls added to failure.py _ALLOWED_FIELDS with privacy rationale (integers, no content). Part 3: completion verdict sidecar build_payload now carries a metrics block (requests/tool_calls/total_ms) on both PASS and FAIL branches. AC4: new RED->GREEN test tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_consumption_sidecar_df94.py proves counters survive to the SIDECAR for a FAILING run (mutation-checked). AC5: rebar audit show dumps the sidecar record generically, surfacing the new metrics. lint+typecheck green; 765 workflow/metrics tests pass.
